name: Bread
oneLiner: BREAD is Bread Cooperative's 1:1 xDAI-backed wrapper on Gnosis Chain that routes accrued Gnosis Savings xDAI yield to cooperative solidarity grants.
collateral: 100% tracked Gnosis Savings xDAI (sDAI) ERC-4626 vault shares (over WXDAI) held directly by the BREAD contract on Gnosis Chain, giving 1:1 atomic backing in native xDAI while routing surplus yield above totalSupply to the Bread Cooperative YieldDistributor.
pegMechanism: Permissionless 1:1 ERC-20 wrapper around native xDAI on Gnosis Chain. Calling mint(receiver) wraps sent native xDAI into WXDAI, deposits it into the Gnosis Savings xDAI (sDAI) vault, and mints BREAD 1:1 with zero fee. Calling burn(amount, receiver) burns caller BREAD, withdraws the exact WXDAI amount from sDAI, unwraps WXDAI, and returns native xDAI 1:1 atomically with zero fee. Accrued savings yield above totalSupply is claimed separately by the Bread Cooperative YieldDistributor for solidarity grants, so BREAD balances stay fixed at 1:1 xDAI.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Pharos Listing Policy v2 addition review (2026-11-27)
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Although BREAD trades and redeems 1:1 against native xDAI (variantOf xdai-gnosis), verified Bread.sol holds 100% of its backing in tracked Gnosis Savings xDAI (sDAI, 0xaf204776c7245bf4147c2612bf6e5972ee483701) ERC-4626 vault shares, which are classified as protocol-position. Assigning protocol-position with archetypeOverride matches the direct sDAI backing layer while preserving serial propagation to xdai-gnosis.
